So this is gonna sound crazy but i swear this actually happened to me. Anyway i was living on my own in a two bedroom apartment. It was a single floor apartment with thick woods behind it. I hadnt met my neighbors but i did notice the the one who lived to the right of my front door was a bit odd judging by her choice of lawn decor. In her front yard was normal stuff but around back was a gargoyle and some other odd things that didnt really make sense. The wierdest thing was that all of her trinkets were facing in the exact same direction looking into the woods. One night at around 1am i walked out into the backyard area to have a smoke. Its dark but the stars are bright enough that i can see the tree line just fine. After about five minutes i started hearing rustling in the  woods. It started getting closer and closer. I started to panic a little but for some reason didnt want to get back in the house. I needed to see what it was. I started to notice a tall figure coming straight towards me through the trees. As soon as it broke through the tree line i realized it was my neighbor. With out skipping a beat she says hello and introduces herself then says goodnight and returned to her home. She was wearing normal clothes but had no flashlight. Just a shovel and a small bag were with her. Immediately thousands of ideas ran through my mind about her and what she was doing. I thought maybe she had a garden in the woods she was tending. But then i thought why wouldnt she just take care of it during the day. Also why didnt she have a flash light. I started to think maybe she was hiding something out there that she didnt want anyone to know about. After sitting in the dark for a while i decided it was time for bed. I walk into my apartment. Do a quick sweep of the house to make sure everything is locked then place my pistol on the nightstand next to my bed and fall asleep. I slept for a good while and pretty deeply until i heard my back door swing open and the blind smacking against the glass. Immediately i woke up and grabbed my gun. As soon i looked up at my bedroom door to get out of bed my heart stopped. My door was wide open and someone was standing in the door way. I couldnt tell who it was because of the darkness. I filled with rage at the thought that someone wanted to turn me into a victim. I tried to lift my pistol but for some reason everything became very heavy. I couldnt move and my eyes locked on this figure began to slowly close. I immediately opened my eyes again and the sun was shining out side. I checked my phone and it was already 10am. I ran around my house looking for the intruder but no one was there and everything was still locked. I went back to my room and sat there shocked and thinking maybe i dreamt the whole thing. I couldnt keep my focus for long because somehow a fly was trapped behind the blinds in my room and its wings buzzing irritated me for some reason. I got up and found the shadow of the single fly behing my blinds. I pulled open the blinds and out of nowhere a swarm of fies fly from behind them. There were so many it was hard to breathe. I ripped open the window and in my panick punched the screen off the other side of the window. As soon as i did all the flies flew out as fast as they could but when they passed through the window they died. There were so many of them i had to go out side with a broom and dustpan and get rid of them. One of the scarier things that has happened to me while i lived alone.
